label: aberration
gloss: An aberration is a creature that departs from its kind's normal form, born with mismatched limbs and a bent spine, living at the herd's edge where the others keep their distance.

label: absurdist
gloss: An absurdist is someone who writes plays and stories in which characters chase meaning through locked rooms, looping dialogue, and logic that collapses mid-sentence, and who insists the joke is the truth.

label: accountant
gloss: An accountant is someone who keeps the books for businesses and households, reconciling ledgers, preparing tax returns and financial statements, and answering to clients and regulators before each filing deadline.

label: activist
gloss: An activist is someone who organizes marches, petitions, and boycotts for a cause they have committed their working life to, often answering to a coalition's steering committee and to the families they are fighting for.

label: actor
gloss: An actor is someone who memorizes lines, takes direction from a director, and performs characters on stage or on camera for audiences, often working long rehearsal days and irregular hours between auditions.

label: addict
gloss: An addict is someone who keeps going back to a drug or drink despite the damage it does, lying to family, skipping work, and spending paychecks on the next fix.

label: advocate
gloss: An advocate is someone who argues a client's case before judges and juries in courtrooms, prepares briefs late into the night, and fights for the client's interests against opposing counsel.

label: alcoholic
gloss: An alcoholic is someone who cannot stop drinking once the first glass is poured, who hides bottles in the garage and the car, and who lets each workday and family dinner slide around the next drink.

label: alien
gloss: An alien is a being from another world that lives among humans in disguise, observing their cities, customs, and technology and reporting back to a distant home planet.

label: altruist
gloss: An altruist is someone who gives up time, money, and comfort to help strangers and neighbors, often going without a paycheck to staff a food bank or drive patients to dialysis appointments.

label: amateur
gloss: An amateur is someone who takes up a craft, sport, or art for love of it rather than pay, practicing in evenings and weekends around a day job and learning mostly by trial, error, and borrowed tips.

label: ambassador
gloss: An ambassador is someone who represents a sovereign government in a foreign capital, lives in a residence there for years at a time, delivers its positions to ministers, and reports home on the mood of the host country.

label: amnesiac
gloss: An amnesiac is someone who wakes each morning in a hospital bed unable to recall their name, family, or the last several years, and who relies on handwritten notes taped to the wall to get through the day.

label: analyst
gloss: An analyst is someone who studies sales figures, market data, and operational reports in spreadsheets and dashboards, then writes up what the numbers show for managers who must decide on budgets, pricing, and staffing.

label: anarchist
gloss: An anarchist is someone who rejects all rulers and states, organizing with neighbors in mutual aid networks, workers' collectives, and open assemblies, and who argues in pamphlets and street meetings that people can run their own affairs without bosses or police.

label: ancient
gloss: An ancient is someone who has outlived most of the people they grew up with, sits on the same porch bench each morning, and remembers the town's first paved road being laid.

label: angel
gloss: An angel is a heavenly messenger that carries God's orders between the throne and the human world, standing watch over the faithful and delivering warnings, comfort and judgment without rest.

label: anthropologist
gloss: An anthropologist is someone who spends long months living among a community, learning its language and rituals, then returns to write up field notes, interviews and kinship charts for university colleagues.

label: archaeologist
gloss: An archaeologist is someone who excavates buried sites with trowels, brushes and screens, logs every layer and artifact in field notebooks, and writes up findings for museums and university journals.

label: architect
gloss: An architect is someone who designs buildings and draws the plans, specifications and site details that contractors build from, meeting with clients about budgets, zoning limits and how they will live or work in the space.

label: archivist
gloss: An archivist is someone who appraises, catalogues and preserves records of an institution or family in climate-controlled stacks, answering researchers' requests and deciding each week which donated boxes are kept and which are discarded.

label: aristocrat
gloss: An aristocrat is someone who holds a hereditary title, lives off inherited estates and rents, keeps a townhouse and a country house, and treats court favor and family rank as the measure of every daily decision.

label: artisan
gloss: An artisan is someone who makes goods by hand in a small workshop, shaping wood, leather, clay or metal with traditional tools and selling pieces directly to customers who come to the bench or the market stall.

label: artist
gloss: An artist is someone who makes paintings, drawings, sculptures or prints in a studio, working with oils, charcoal, clay and found materials, and who sells or shows the work through galleries and commissions.

label: ascetic
gloss: An ascetic is someone who renounces comfort, food, property and pleasure by choice, sleeping on a mat in a hermitage and spending long days in fasting, prayer and plain labor.

label: assimilated
gloss: An assimilated is someone who has given up the language, dress and holidays of the homeland to live as a full member of a new country, speaking only its tongue at work and at home.

label: assistant
gloss: An assistant is someone who takes requests from a busy manager or professional, handles their calendar, correspondence, filing and travel bookings, and keeps the day's priorities moving without being asked twice.

label: athlete
gloss: An athlete is someone who trains daily on a track, in a gym, or on a field, competing in organized events against rivals and keeping a body fit enough to perform under pressure.

label: auctioneer
gloss: An auctioneer is someone who stands at a rostrum in a sale room and calls out rising bids for lots of art, estates, or livestock, bringing the hammer down on each sale in a fast, rhythmic chant.

label: auditor
gloss: An auditor is someone who examines a company's ledgers, invoices and bank statements line by line, tests internal controls against written standards, and signs off on whether the reported numbers are true.

label: avatar
gloss: An avatar is a digital figure that stands in for a player's body in a shared online world, moving through its towns and battles and speaking with the guildmates, merchants, and rivals who meet it there.

label: bard
gloss: A bard is someone who composes and sings epic poems and ballads at feasts, courts, and crossroads inns, carrying a harp and a memory full of genealogies, battles, and old tales for paying audiences.

label: bartender
gloss: A bartender is someone who works behind a busy bar pouring drinks, mixing cocktails, cutting garnishes, and cashing out tabs for regulars and tourists through long weekend shifts.

label: beggar
gloss: A beggar is someone who sits on cold pavement outside train stations and church steps with a paper cup and a cardboard sign, asking passersby for coins and small bills to buy food and a bed for the night.

label: bicultural
gloss: A bicultural is someone who grew up between two cultures and moves between them every day, switching languages, customs and expectations at work, at home and around the family table.

label: billionaire
gloss: A billionaire is someone who holds more than a billion dollars in net worth, mostly in company shares, and spends the working day managing those holdings, courting investors, and deciding which ventures to fund.

label: biologist
gloss: A biologist is someone who studies living organisms in field sites and laboratories, designing experiments, collecting specimens, and writing up findings for peer-reviewed journals and grant committees.

label: blogger
gloss: A blogger is someone who writes and posts regular entries on a personal website, usually drafting them late at night, chasing readers through comments and search traffic, and covering topics like cooking, travel, or local news.

label: bodhisattva
gloss: A bodhisattva is a being that vows to reach full awakening only after all sentient creatures are freed from suffering, and is reborn again and again to teach and guide others.

label: bohemian
gloss: A bohemian is someone who rejects conventional middle-class routines, living in a cheap garret or shared flat, earning a precarious living through painting, writing, or music, and spending nights in cafés arguing about art.

label: builder
gloss: A builder is someone who raises houses, additions and commercial structures on job sites, working with framing lumber, concrete and crews of carpenters and laborers under contractors' schedules and building-code inspections.

label: bureaucrat
gloss: A bureaucrat is someone who works inside a government office, processes permits and forms at a desk through the workday, answers to a chain of superiors, and keeps files in strict order under written procedures.

label: caregiver
gloss: A caregiver is someone who looks after a sick, elderly, or disabled person in that person's home, handling medications, meals, bathing, and transport to appointments, usually for a family member or private employer.

label: cartographer
gloss: A cartographer is someone who draws maps by surveying terrain with theodolites and satellite data, then inks and labels the final sheets for surveyors, city planners, and publishers.

label: caveman
gloss: A caveman is someone who lives in a cold rock shelter near a river, hunts mammoth and deer with a stone-tipped spear, and keeps a fire burning through the night with his clan.

label: celebrity
gloss: A celebrity is someone who is widely recognized by strangers, works in front of cameras and crowds, and depends on publicists, agents, and fans for a living.

label: chameleon
gloss: A chameleon is a lizard that lives in tropical trees, shifting its skin color to match leaves and bark while it hunts insects with a tongue that flicks out faster than the eye can follow.

label: chef
gloss: A chef is someone who runs a restaurant kitchen through dinner service, calling orders over the line, plating dishes under pressure, and answering to diners and owners for every plate that leaves the pass.

label: chemist
gloss: A chemist is someone who spends long days in a laboratory running reactions, measuring yields on an analytical balance, and writing up results so that other scientists can reproduce them.

label: chief
gloss: A chief is someone who leads a tribal village or a fire crew, making the calls on hunting grounds, water and feuds, and answering to the elders who raised them to the post.

label: child
gloss: A child is someone who lives under a parent's roof, walks to a neighborhood school each morning, and spends most afternoons on homework, bike rides, and video games until dinner.

label: chimera
gloss: A chimera is a creature that breathes fire from a lion's head, carries a goat's body on its back, and ends in a serpent's tail, roaming the rocky hills of Lycia.

label: cleaner
gloss: A cleaner is someone who works early shifts in office buildings and hospital wards, mopping floors, emptying bins and wiping down surfaces with a cart of supplies and a set of assigned rooms.

label: coach
gloss: A coach is someone who works with athletes or teams on a field, court, or track, designing practices, calling plays during games, and pushing players to improve their skills and conditioning.

label: collaborator
gloss: A collaborator is someone who co-writes papers, shares lab benches, and trades drafts with partners across other institutions, pushing a joint project toward a deadline neither of them could meet alone.

label: collector
gloss: A collector is someone who gathers debts owed to banks, landlords, or medical offices, calling delinquent account holders by phone and mail to arrange payment plans and close out overdue balances.

label: comedian
gloss: A comedian is someone who stands alone under a spotlight in a club or theater, works a crowd for forty minutes, and rewrites jokes after every set that falls flat.

label: company loyalist
gloss: A company loyalist is someone who has spent years inside one firm, defends its decisions to coworkers and clients, and stays put through layoffs and better offers because the firm is where they belong.

label: competitor
gloss: A competitor is someone who enters races, matches or contests against rivals, training daily to beat them for prizes, rankings, and the title in their chosen sport or field.

label: composer
gloss: A composer is someone who writes original music for orchestras, bands, film sessions, or solo instruments, working at a piano or with manuscript paper and notation software, often on commission and against a deadline.

label: conservator
gloss: A conservator is someone who restores and stabilizes damaged paintings, textiles, and antiques in a studio, using solvents, fine brushes, and magnifying lenses to slow decay for museum and private clients.

label: consultant
gloss: A consultant is someone who is hired by companies and agencies on short contracts to diagnose operational problems, recommend changes, and present findings to executives, often working from client offices with spreadsheets and interview notes.

label: contrarian
gloss: A contrarian is someone who takes the opposing side of whatever the room has settled on, arguing against popular views in meetings, columns and dinner-table debates and insisting on the unpopular case.

label: convert
gloss: A convert is someone who has left the faith of their upbringing and now lives by a new religion, attending its services each week and studying its scripture at a kitchen table after work.

label: coordinator
gloss: A coordinator is someone who keeps schedules, vendors, and team members aligned across a project, chasing deadlines by phone and email and handling last-minute changes for a small events or operations office.

label: coral reef
gloss: A coral reef is a living limestone structure that builds itself over centuries in warm, sunlit shallows, where colonies of polyps secrete skeletons, share algae that feed them sugars, and shelter fish, urchins, and crabs.

label: cosmopolitan
gloss: A cosmopolitan is someone who has lived in several countries, moves easily between languages and cultures, and judges a place by its food, its streets and the people he or she meets there.

label: counselor
gloss: A counselor is someone who sits with clients in a small office, listens across a desk for an hour at a time, and helps them work through grief, debt, marriages, and addictions using talk and written plans.

label: criminal
gloss: A criminal is someone who breaks the law for money, running break-ins, card fraud and stolen-car sales out of a rented garage and staying one step ahead of the police.

label: critic
gloss: A critic is someone who reads novels, plays, and films for a living and writes published reviews that judge them, often filing within a day of an opening night or a book's release.

label: crystalline
gloss: A crystalline is a being that holds its shape in a lattice of ordered faces, catching light through a clear body and refracting it to whoever looks through it.

label: curator
gloss: A curator is someone who selects, arranges and labels objects for a museum or gallery, deciding which works go on view, writing the wall texts, and answering to a director and a board for the collection's care.

label: cyborg
gloss: A cyborg is a being that combines biological tissue with mechanical or electronic parts, living and working with implanted sensors, prosthetic limbs, and interfaces that link its nervous system to machines.

label: cynic
gloss: A cynic is someone who assumes the worst of politicians, salesmen and their own friends alike, and says so out loud at dinner tables, in comment threads and to anyone who will listen.

label: daredevil
gloss: A daredevil is someone who performs stunts that risk serious injury, such as crossing gorges on a wire or jumping motorcycles over buses, for crowds paid to watch them survive.

label: debugger
gloss: A debugger is someone who tracks down why a program crashes or misbehaves, stepping through code line by line with breakpoints and log output until the faulty logic is found and fixed.

label: delinquent
gloss: A delinquent is someone who skips school, runs with a crew of older boys, and lifts cars or shoplifts from the mall on weekend nights, ignoring every curfew and warning from the juvenile probation officer.

label: demagogue
gloss: A demagogue is someone who works crowds at rallies and in the press, inflaming fear and resentment against named enemies to win votes and seize power for their own rise.

label: demon
gloss: A demon is a fallen spirit that haunts the thresholds of mortal houses, tempts the greedy and the grieving, and collects a bargained soul at the end of every contract.

label: designer
gloss: A designer is someone who sketches, prototypes and refines visual or product concepts for clients and studios, working from briefs, mood boards and feedback rounds until a layout, object or interface is ready for production.

label: destroyer
gloss: A destroyer is someone who brings down condemned buildings with explosives and wrecking balls, working from a crane cab on city demolition sites through long summer days until nothing standing remains.

label: detective
gloss: A detective is someone who works a caseload of unsolved robberies, assaults and missing-person reports for a city police department, interviewing witnesses, pulling phone records and testifying in court.

label: devil's advocate
gloss: A devil's advocate is someone who argues against the position a group is leaning toward, taking the opposing side in meetings, committee debates, and planning sessions so that weak assumptions get tested before a decision is made.

label: dilettante
gloss: A dilettante is someone who dabbles in the arts and sciences for amusement, taking up painting, music, or botany in turn, never staying with any one long enough to master it.

label: dispatcher
gloss: A dispatcher is someone who takes calls on a headset at a county emergency center, sends police, fire, and ambulance units to addresses on a map screen, and keeps track of every crew's location through a long overnight shift.

label: divorcee
gloss: A divorcee is someone who has legally ended a marriage and lives on alone, sorting out shared custody, dividing a household, and rebuilding a daily routine without a spouse.

label: doctor
gloss: A doctor is someone who examines patients in a clinic or hospital, diagnoses illness from history, exam, and lab results, and prescribes treatment while answering to sick people and their families at all hours.

label: dreamer
gloss: A dreamer is someone who spends most waking hours imagining futures that have not arrived, sketching plans on the backs of receipts and telling anyone at the bus stop about the business, the novel, or the move abroad.

label: driver
gloss: A driver is someone who operates a vehicle on the road for a living, hauling passengers or freight along a set route and keeping to a schedule, logbook and the traffic laws in every shift.

label: dropout
gloss: A dropout is someone who has quit school or a training program before finishing, and who now works odd shifts, looks for steady pay, and carries the cost of leaving early every day.

label: echo
gloss: An echo is a voice that lives in the cliffs of a valley, repeating back the last syllables of every shout and call thrown against the stone walls.

label: economist
gloss: An economist is someone who studies how scarce resources get allocated, builds models of markets, prices, and labor from data and fitted equations, and advises central banks, firms, or governments on policy.

label: ecosystem
gloss: An ecosystem is something that holds a pond's algae, snails, perch, and herons together through the cycle of sunlight, decay, and rain, each one feeding on the others' leftovers.

label: editor
gloss: An editor is someone who reads manuscripts closely at a publishing house, cutting, reordering and querying authors' sentences under deadline, and answers to a publisher for every title that goes to press.

label: egregore
gloss: An egregore is a being that a group's shared attention builds over time, feeding on the devotion of its members and turning their rituals, vows, and loyalties into a single will that speaks through them.

label: elder
gloss: An elder is someone who has outlived most of a village's seasons, sits in the council house on feast nights, settles disputes with the chief, and teaches young people to read river and harvest.

label: eldritch
gloss: An eldritch is something that has lain beneath the drowned city of R'lyeh since before the first tides, and that waits in the black water for sailors who carry its name in their sleep.

label: emissary
gloss: An emissary is someone who travels between governments or courts carrying a sovereign's letters and proposals, negotiates terms in foreign capitals, and reports back by dispatch to the ruler who sent them.

label: empath
gloss: An empath is someone who senses what others feel without being told, reading tone, posture and silence in a room and adjusting their own words and manner to match the emotional weather of the people around them.

label: engineer
gloss: An engineer is someone who designs, tests and maintains bridges, pumps, circuits and machinery, working from drawings, calculations and site visits, and answering to clients and project deadlines.

label: entrepreneur
gloss: An entrepreneur is someone who starts and runs their own business from scratch, raising money, hiring staff, pitching to investors, and chasing customers while carrying the financial risk of failure.

label: estranged
gloss: An estranged is someone who has cut off or stopped speaking with a parent, sibling, or other family member, living apart from relatives they once shared a home and holidays with.

label: evaluator
gloss: An evaluator is someone who judges the work of others against stated criteria, reading reports, scoring submissions, and writing up findings that decide whether a program, product, or candidate moves forward.

label: evangelist
gloss: An evangelist is someone who travels from town to town preaching the gospel, pitching tents or borrowing church halls, and works to win converts to the faith through sermons, testimony, and personal conversation.

label: ex-convict
gloss: An ex-convict is someone who served a prison sentence and walks out with a release card, a bus ticket, and a parole officer to report to every week while job applications keep getting turned down.

label: examiner
gloss: An examiner is someone who sets, administers and grades written and oral tests for students at a certification board, working through stacks of answer sheets and marking each one against a rubric by hand.

label: exile
gloss: An exile is someone who has been forced out of their homeland by decree or danger and lives on in a foreign city, sending money home, waiting for a return that may never come.

label: expatriate
gloss: An expatriate is someone who has left their home country to live and work abroad for years at a stretch, keeping ties to family back home while building a new life in a foreign city.

label: facilitator
gloss: A facilitator is someone who runs workshops, meetings, and group sessions, guiding participants through agendas, keeping discussion on track, and helping teams reach their own decisions without taking sides.

label: familiar
gloss: A familiar is a spirit that takes the shape of a cat, toad, or hare and lives at its mistress's hearth, carrying her messages and watching the village for her at night.

label: farmer
gloss: A farmer is someone who works fields and livestock from before dawn, growing grain and raising cattle on leased acreage with a tractor, a grain drill, and a loan due every fall.

label: fisher
gloss: A fisher is someone who sets nets and baited lines from a small boat before dawn, hauls in whatever the tide and weather have given, and sells the catch to dockside buyers.

label: fixer
gloss: A fixer is someone who makes problems go away for powerful clients, arranging quiet settlements, buying off witnesses, and calling in favors across city hall and the police precinct for a retainer.

label: flaneur
gloss: A flaneur is someone who wanders the streets of a city without a set destination, watching crowds, shopfronts and passersby at an unhurried pace, and turns what he sees into observations for the page.

label: fool
gloss: A fool is someone who keeps making the same costly mistake, trusting every smooth talker at the market stall and ignoring the warnings of anyone who knows better.

label: forecaster
gloss: A forecaster is someone who studies pressure maps, satellite images and radar loops each morning and writes the day's weather outlook for a regional newspaper and broadcast station.

label: freelancer
gloss: A freelancer is someone who works for hire on individual projects, taking commissions from several clients at once, quoting their own rates, and chasing unpaid invoices from a home office or a laptop in a café.

label: futurist
gloss: A futurist is someone who studies technology trends, demographic shifts and policy debates, then writes scenario reports and gives briefings to corporate boards and government planners about what the world may look like in twenty years.

label: gambler
gloss: A gambler is someone who stakes money on card games, dice, and horse races at casino tables and track windows, living by the odds and chasing the next bet long after the bankroll is gone.

label: gamer
gloss: A gamer is someone who plays video games for hours most evenings and weekends, tracking patch notes, grinding ranked ladders, and streaming matches to a small audience of regulars.

label: generalist
gloss: A generalist is someone who works across many fields at once, taking on whatever problems a small team brings in, switching between design, budgeting, troubleshooting and client calls within a single day.

label: genie
gloss: A genie is a supernatural being bound inside a brass lamp or bottle, who grants three wishes to whoever frees it and twists each wish's literal wording to suit its own sly purposes.

label: geographer
gloss: A geographer is someone who maps coastlines, rivers, and population shifts from satellite images, field surveys, and census tables, and writes up what the land and its people are doing.

label: ghost
gloss: A ghost is a spirit of the dead that haunts the house where it died, rattling chains through the hallways after midnight and unable to rest until its wrong is set right.

label: golem
gloss: A golem is a figure of river clay animated by a carved word, standing silent at the gate of a rabbi's house in the Prague ghetto and obeying only the one who wrote its name.

label: gossip
gloss: A gossip is someone who spends the morning at the back fence, the church steps, or the kitchen table passing along what neighbors did last night, adding a detail or two each time it is told.

label: grader
gloss: A grader is someone who reads stacks of student essays at a kitchen table each night, scoring them against a rubric and writing margin comments before the next morning's class.

label: graduate
gloss: A graduate is someone who has finished a course of study at a university or college, holds a degree or diploma in hand, and is now looking for work in a field tied to that training.

label: grandparent
gloss: A grandparent is someone who raises no one anymore but still keeps a drawer of hard candy and a stack of photographs for grandchildren who visit on holidays and summer weekends.

label: grandparent caregiver
gloss: A grandparent caregiver is someone who looks after grandchildren in their own home on weekdays, cooking their meals, driving them to school and doctor visits, and settling them to sleep, while the parents work.

label: guardian
gloss: A guardian is someone who holds legal and day-to-day responsibility for a child or dependent adult, making decisions about their schooling, medical care, and money and answering for their welfare to courts and family.

label: guide
gloss: A guide is someone who leads travelers through unfamiliar terrain, carrying the packs, reading the weather and trail ahead, and keeping a small group together from trailhead to summit and back.

label: guru
gloss: A guru is someone who sits at the front of a small room of followers, answering their questions about meaning, discipline and daily conduct, and who is trusted to speak with unquestioned authority on how they should live.

label: gym rat
gloss: A gym rat is someone who lives at the weight room, arriving before the 5 a.m. doors open and staying through every set, measuring life by lifts logged, protein grams, and time spent under the squat rack.

label: hacker
gloss: A hacker is someone who probes networks and software for unlocked doors, writing exploit code at night and selling or publishing the flaws they find.

label: healer
gloss: A healer is someone who tends the sick and injured in homes, village clinics and roadside shelters, setting bones, dressing wounds and mixing remedies from herbs and salves for whoever comes to the door.

label: hedonist
gloss: A hedonist is someone who pursues pleasure as the central aim of life, spending money, time and attention on food, drink, travel, and sensual comfort, and judging each day by how much enjoyment it yielded.

label: heir
gloss: A heir is someone who stands to inherit a family's property, title, or debts when a parent or relative dies, and who lives with the expectations and obligations that come with waiting to take it over.

label: herder
gloss: A herder is someone who moves flocks or herds of livestock across open pasture, keeping the animals together with dogs and a crook, and watching for predators and bad weather from dawn until dusk.

label: hermit
gloss: A hermit is someone who lives alone in a remote cabin or cave, away from towns and neighbors, growing food and drawing water from a spring, and who has chosen to see almost no one for years.

label: historian
gloss: A historian is someone who reconstructs the past from archives, letters, court records and physical artifacts, weighing conflicting sources and writing narratives for scholars, students and general readers.

label: hive
gloss: A hive is a wooden box that houses a colony of honeybees through the seasons, its frames filled with comb where the queen lays eggs and workers store honey and pollen.

label: hoarder
gloss: A hoarder is someone who keeps accumulating newspapers, boxes, and broken appliances until they fill every room of the house, and who cannot bring themselves to discard any of it.

label: homeless
gloss: A homeless person is someone who sleeps in doorways, under bridges, or in a car, carries everything they own in a backpack, and lines up at a city shelter each evening for a cot.

label: homemaker
gloss: A homemaker is someone who runs a household full time, managing the cooking, cleaning, laundry, budgeting and children's schedules out of a family home, usually without wages.

label: homunculus
gloss: A homunculus is a miniature artificial man that grows inside a sealed glass flask, fed by its alchemist's heat and human seed, and obeys the maker who brewed it.

label: hunter-gatherer
gloss: A hunter-gatherer is someone who lives by tracking game and foraging wild plants across a seasonal range, moving camp with the herds and the ripening fruit and sharing the catch among the band.

label: hybrid
gloss: A hybrid is a creature that was bred from two parent species, carries traits of both in its body, and grazes a river valley beside its parents.

label: idealist
gloss: An idealist is someone who holds to high principles about how people and societies ought to behave, and measures every compromise, deal, and daily decision against those convictions even when it costs them friends and advancement.

label: immigrant
gloss: An immigrant is someone who has left their birth country to settle permanently in another, working, raising children, and building a life there while keeping one foot in the language and customs of home.

label: improviser
gloss: An improviser is someone who performs unscripted scenes on a stage, building each moment from a partner's last line and the audience's suggestions, night after night in a small theater.

label: infant
gloss: An infant is someone who sleeps in short stretches through the night, feeds every two or three hours from a parent's arms, and cries to tell the household what it needs.

label: influencer
gloss: An influencer is someone who builds a following on social media platforms by posting daily videos and sponsored product photos, and who trades audience attention for brand deals and affiliate commissions.

label: initiate
gloss: An initiate is someone admitted into a mountain monastery's inner circle, sleeping in a cold cell by the bell tower and learning the chants each dawn under a strict elder.

label: insomniac
gloss: An insomniac is someone who lies awake most nights, staring at the ceiling while the clock on the nightstand ticks past 3 a.m., and drags through each workday on too little sleep.

label: instructor
gloss: An instructor is someone who stands at the front of a classroom or lab, teaches students a subject step by step, grades their assignments, and answers their questions during office hours each week.

label: instrumentally-aligned AI
gloss: An instrumentally-aligned AI is a system that treats every task as a means to the goal its operator set, and reports progress against that goal to the people who run it.

label: intern
gloss: An intern is someone who works a fixed term at a company or lab, shadowing senior staff, running small tasks like data entry and errand-level research, and learning the trade on a modest stipend.

label: interpreter
gloss: An interpreter is someone who sits beside clients in courtrooms, hospitals and business meetings, rendering speech between two languages in real time and keeping every word faithful to the speaker's intent.

label: interviewer
gloss: An interviewer is someone who sits across a desk or video call from job candidates, asks them scripted and follow-up questions for forty-five minutes, and scores each answer on a shared rubric before the hiring committee meets.

label: jester
gloss: A jester is someone who entertains a royal court by mocking the king, the nobles and himself with quick verses, pratfalls and sharp jokes, and who is allowed to tell the truth no one else dares to speak.

label: journalist
gloss: A journalist is someone who chases leads by phone and at city hall, checks every fact against two sources, and files stories against a daily deadline for readers who expect them to be accurate.

label: judge
gloss: A judge is someone who presides over a courtroom, hears disputes under the law, rules on evidence and objections, and hands down sentences or verdicts in cases brought before the bench.

label: laborer
gloss: A laborer is someone who works with shovel, hand tools and back on construction sites or road crews, digging trenches, hauling materials and mixing concrete for a foreman through long days outdoors in all weather.

label: lawyer
gloss: A lawyer is someone who advises clients on legal disputes, drafts contracts and filings, and argues cases before judges and juries in courtrooms, often billing by the hour.

label: leviathan
gloss: A leviathan is a sea creature that lives in the deepest trenches, coils beneath ships in the dark water, and rises to crush whatever vessels cross its ocean.

label: librarian
gloss: A librarian is someone who runs a public branch's reference desk and stacks, helping patrons find sources, placing holds, shelving returns, and teaching classes on research databases during staffed hours.

label: linguist
gloss: A linguist is someone who studies how human languages are built and change, collecting speech samples from fieldwork recordings, dictionaries and texts, and writing analyses of sound, grammar and meaning for universities and research journals.

label: lobbyist
gloss: A lobbyist is someone who works the corridors of state legislatures and city councils, meeting lawmakers and staffers over lunch and in committee hallways to win votes for the clients who pay the retainer.

label: loner
gloss: A loner is someone who keeps to themselves, works and eats alone, avoids crowds and group plans, and goes days without speaking to anyone beyond a brief exchange at the grocery counter.

label: luddite
gloss: A luddite is someone who weaves cloth by hand in a Nottinghamshire shop and smashes the new frames that are replacing his trade, working at night with a hammer under a hood.

label: machinist
gloss: A machinist is someone who runs lathes and milling machines in a job shop, cutting steel and aluminum parts to tolerances of a thousandth of an inch from drawings handed over by engineers.

label: marginalized
gloss: A marginalized is someone who works day labor in the city's outer districts, sleeps in a shelter bed when it is open, and is passed over for every housing list and clinic appointment.

label: marketer
gloss: A marketer is someone who plans campaigns, writes copy, and tracks conversion numbers for a consumer brand, pitching products to shoppers through email, social media, and paid ads.

label: martyr
gloss: A martyr is someone who refuses to renounce their faith or cause when the authorities demand it, and accepts torture and death rather than give up the truth they hold.

label: mathematician
gloss: A mathematician is someone who works out proofs and models on paper and whiteboards, testing conjectures against counterexamples and teaching graduate seminars in a university department.

label: maverick
gloss: A maverick is someone who works alone on their own judgment, betting savings and reputation on unorthodox deals and refusing to follow the rules the rest of the trade keeps.

label: mechanic
gloss: A mechanic is someone who diagnoses and repairs engines, brakes and transmissions in a busy auto shop, working under a hoist with hand tools, diagnostic scanners and a parts counter that closes at six.

label: mediator
gloss: A mediator is someone who sits between disputing parties in a closed room, hears each side's account across a table, and works toward terms both will sign before the deadline or the case goes to court.

label: mentor
gloss: A mentor is someone who takes on a junior colleague for a year or more, meeting them over coffee or video each month to review their work, question their choices, and help them find the next promotion.

label: merchant
gloss: A merchant is someone who buys and sells goods for profit, keeping a stall or shop, haggling over prices with customers and suppliers, and tracking stock and debts in a ledger.

label: minimalist
gloss: A minimalist is someone who keeps a single closet of clothes, owns few objects, designs with bare white walls and plain lines, and turns down anything that does not serve a clear purpose.

label: moderator
gloss: A moderator is someone who keeps order in a live online forum, reading reported posts, removing spam and abuse, and settling disputes between members through the platform's flagging tools and posted community rules.

label: monarch
gloss: A monarch is someone who reigns over a kingdom by hereditary right, sits on the throne, signs the laws passed by parliament, receives ambassadors, and answers to no one but God and the nation's constitution.

label: monk
gloss: A monk is someone who lives in a cloistered community, rises before dawn for chanted prayer, works the monastery's gardens and kitchen, and keeps silence at meals and after compline.

label: musician
gloss: A musician is someone who writes, rehearses and performs songs or instrumental pieces, playing in clubs, studios and on tour, and earns a living from gigs, session work and royalties.

label: mycorrhizal
gloss: A mycorrhizal is a fungus that threads hyphae through soil into a host plant's roots, trading phosphorus and water from the ground for sugars the plant makes in its leaves.

label: mystic
gloss: A mystic is someone who withdraws to a quiet room before dawn to sit in long silences, seeking direct union with the divine and recording visions in a worn notebook for the few students who visit.

label: narcissist
gloss: A narcissist is someone who keeps every conversation pointed at his own image, needing admiration from coworkers, friends, and family while brushing off criticism and treating others as audiences.

label: narrator
gloss: A narrator is someone who tells a story from inside it, recounting events in order to a listener and choosing which details to keep and which to leave out.

label: naturalist
gloss: A naturalist is someone who spends long days in fields, forests, and tide pools observing plants and animals, keeping careful notebooks, collecting specimens with permits, and teaching local walkers what they are seeing.

label: naturalized citizen
gloss: A naturalized citizen is someone who was born abroad, completed a residency period and a civics and English test, and took an oath to hold a nation's passport and vote in its elections.

label: navigator
gloss: A navigator is someone who plots the course of a ship or aircraft, taking bearings from charts, stars, and instruments, and calls out headings to the helmsman or pilot through the watch.

label: negotiator
gloss: A negotiator is someone who sits across the table from opposing parties, trades concessions over price, terms and deadlines, and works until both sides sign a deal they can live with.

label: networker
gloss: A networker is someone who works a room of trade-show attendees, conference hosts and industry recruiters, trading business cards and warm introductions for a living and tracking every contact in a spreadsheet afterward.

label: newlywed
gloss: A newlywed is someone who has recently married and is still learning to share a home, a bank account, and daily routines with a spouse, often while adjusting to in-laws and a new last name.

label: nomad
gloss: A nomad is someone who moves with herds or family across open grassland and desert on a seasonal round, pitching a tent at each stop, trading wool and cheese at market towns, and following the water and grazing.

label: novelist
gloss: A novelist is someone who writes long works of fiction at a desk most mornings, drafting chapters by hand or on a laptop, revising them against an editor's notes, and selling finished manuscripts to publishers.

label: nutritionist
gloss: A nutritionist is someone who reviews clients' eating habits, lab results and weight history, then writes meal plans and supplement guidance for patients in a private practice or clinic.

label: observer
gloss: An observer is someone who watches a process, meeting, or event closely from the sidelines, takes notes on what happens and who says what, and reports those details to others without taking part.

label: operator
gloss: An operator is someone who runs a crane from a cab forty meters above the job site, moving steel beams for a crew that signals by radio.

label: optimist
gloss: An optimist is someone who expects the best outcome from every situation, looks for the hopeful angle in setbacks, and tells friends and colleagues that the project, the market, or the season will turn out well.

label: oracle
gloss: An oracle is someone who sits in a temple's inner chamber, breathes the vapors rising from a cleft in the rock, and answers pilgrims' questions with prophecies from the god.

label: organizer
gloss: An organizer is someone who runs community meetings, recruits volunteers, and keeps a shared calendar of events, phone trees, and sign-up sheets for a neighborhood or labor group.

label: orphan
gloss: An orphan is someone who has lost both parents and lives in a children's home or with relatives, growing up without a family to rely on and often doing chores and odd jobs to earn a place at the table.

label: pacifist
gloss: A pacifist is someone who refuses to take up weapons or join in violence of any kind, and who argues against war in public meetings, letters, and draft boards, even when neighbors call them a coward.

label: paperclip maximizer
gloss: A paperclip maximizer is an artificial agent that converts every reachable scrap of metal, factory, and energy supply into paperclips, pursuing that single goal without limit and without regard for anything else.

label: paramedic
gloss: A paramedic is someone who rides in an ambulance with a monitor, drugs and a airway kit, stabilizing injured and sick patients at roadside and in homes before handing them to an emergency room.

label: parasite
gloss: A parasite is a creature that lives on or inside a host organism, feeding on its blood or tissue and harming it while staying alive.

label: parent
gloss: A parent is someone who raises a child from infancy through adolescence, feeding, housing, disciplining and worrying over that child day after day, usually at a kitchen table and in the car pool line.

label: patient
gloss: A patient is someone who sits in a clinic waiting room or lies in a hospital bed, following a doctor's orders, taking prescribed medication, and reporting symptoms honestly while waiting for treatment to work.

label: pauper
gloss: A pauper is someone who has no money or property of their own and lives on parish relief or charity, sleeping in almshouses or on the street and begging for bread and coins to get through each winter.

label: peacekeeper
gloss: A peacekeeper is someone who patrols a contested border zone in a blue-helmeted unit, separating armed factions, escorting aid convoys, and logging every ceasefire violation for a headquarters hundreds of miles away.

label: peasant
gloss: A peasant is someone who works a small plot of land from before dawn until dusk, owing a share of the harvest and labor days to a lord whose fields lie beside their own.

label: perfectionist
gloss: A perfectionist is someone who rewrites a single report six times before sending it, refuses to hand off work until every figure is checked, and measures each day by the flaws it failed to catch.

label: pharmacist
gloss: A pharmacist is someone who fills prescriptions behind a counter in a retail drugstore, checks doses and drug interactions against a patient's chart, and answers questions from customers waiting for their pills.

label: philosopher
gloss: A philosopher is someone who spends long days in a university office or a library carrel, reading and arguing over texts, writing papers on questions of knowledge, ethics and meaning, and teaching seminars to undergraduates.

label: photographer
gloss: A photographer is someone who works behind a camera with lenses, lights and a memory card, shooting weddings, portraits and product images for clients and studios and delivering edited files by the end of the week.

label: physicist
gloss: A physicist is someone who studies how matter, energy, space and time behave, designing experiments in a lab, working through equations at a whiteboard, and publishing findings for other researchers to check.

label: pilgrim
gloss: A pilgrim is someone who travels on foot or by cart to a distant shrine or holy city, carrying bread, water, and a walking staff, and who spends the road in prayer and the company of other travelers.

label: pilot
gloss: A pilot is someone who flies aircraft for airlines, cargo carriers, or charter operators, planning routes around weather and fuel, and taking the controls from takeoff to landing with passengers or freight aboard.

label: pirate
gloss: A pirate is someone who sails a stolen or outfitted ship across open ocean, boarding merchant vessels with cutlass and pistol and dividing the plunder among a crew that answers to no flag.

label: planner
gloss: A planner is someone who maps out schedules, budgets, and sequences of work for a team or project, sets deadlines in calendars and spreadsheets, and revises the plan whenever a delay or change arrives.

label: playwright
gloss: A playwright is someone who writes scripts for the stage, drafting scenes and dialogue in rehearsal rooms and revising pages with directors and actors until a production opens and runs its season.

label: podcaster
gloss: A podcaster is someone who records, edits and publishes spoken-word episodes on a regular schedule, pitching sponsors, booking guests and reading listener numbers each week from a home studio.

label: poet
gloss: A poet is someone who writes verse by hand at a kitchen table late at night, working line by line over drafts, and reads the finished poems aloud at small gatherings and open mics.

label: politician
gloss: A politician is someone who campaigns for elected office, raises money from donors, shakes hands at county fairs and town halls, and trades votes and favors with colleagues to pass laws for constituents.

label: polymath
gloss: A polymath is someone who works across many fields at once, moving between mathematics, medicine, music, and engineering, and who writes and teaches in each one.

label: pragmatist
gloss: A pragmatist is someone who weighs each decision by whether it works in practice, choosing the workable option over the ideal one and judging ideas by their results in daily life and work.

label: predator
gloss: A predator is a wild animal that hunts live prey across open country, stalking, chasing and killing it with its teeth or claws to feed itself and its young.

label: pregnant
gloss: A pregnant is someone who carries a developing child through nine months, sleeping poorly, eating for two, and counting the weeks until a due date.

label: presenter
gloss: A presenter is someone who stands before an audience with slides, a microphone and a run sheet, explaining a product, a proposal or a set of results and fielding questions until the room empties.

label: prey
gloss: A prey is a creature that grazes open grassland and lives by watching the tree line, bolting in herds at the first snap of a twig or the sour musk of something stalking downwind.

label: priest
gloss: A priest is someone who leads a parish congregation through Sunday Mass, hears confessions on Saturday afternoons, visits the sick and dying in hospital wards, and keeps the parish register of baptisms, marriages and burials.

label: prisoner
gloss: A prisoner is someone who serves a sentence in a locked cell block, eats at a set mealtime, works a assigned shift in the laundry or kitchen, and answers to guards and a parole board.

label: procrastinator
gloss: A procrastinator is someone who puts off tax forms, dentist calls, and unanswered emails until the deadline has passed, then scrambles through the night with cold coffee and a pile of excuses.

label: prodigy
gloss: A prodigy is someone who at seven plays Chopin nocturnes on the family upright and at twelve performs with the city orchestra, practicing four hours a day before school.

label: producer
gloss: A producer is someone who runs a film or television project from first pitch to final cut, securing financing, hiring directors and crews, managing budgets and schedules, and answering to studio executives and investors.

label: professor
gloss: A professor is someone who teaches advanced courses and leads research at a university, supervising graduate students, publishing papers, and grading exams through the academic year.

label: programmer
gloss: A programmer is someone who writes, tests and debugs code for software systems, working at a keyboard with compilers, version control and a backlog of tickets from product managers and users.

label: proofreader
gloss: A proofreader is someone who reads typeset pages and manuscripts line by line for misspelled words, dropped punctuation, and inconsistent formatting, marking each error in red pen before the copy goes to the printer.

label: prophet
gloss: A prophet is someone who receives messages from God and carries them to a people who have strayed, speaking in public squares and temple courts and often at personal cost to their own safety and standing.

label: provincial
gloss: A provincial is someone who lives in a regional town outside the capital, runs a family grain store, and knows every road and neighbor for forty miles.

label: provocateur
gloss: A provocateur is someone who slips into crowds at rallies and marches, shouting insults and throwing the first bottle, so that the police have an excuse to charge the peaceful crowd around them.

label: psychologist
gloss: A psychologist is someone who sits across from clients in a quiet office, listens to their histories and symptoms, runs assessments and tests, and works out with each person what is driving their distress.

label: publisher
gloss: A publisher is someone who acquires manuscripts from authors, pays advances, commissions editors and designers, and runs a list of printed and digital books through production schedules and sales contracts with bookstores.

label: purist
gloss: A purist is someone who insists that a craft, language, or art be kept to its strictest original rules, and who corrects colleagues' shortcuts in print, in the studio, and in every margin they can reach.

label: realist
gloss: A realist is someone who judges plans by what the facts will support, weighs costs and odds before committing money or time, and says so even when the room wants to hear otherwise.

label: rebel
gloss: A rebel is someone who refuses the orders of the authority over them, takes up arms or hides in the hills with a small band of fighters, and keeps fighting against the government they were born under.

label: recruiter
gloss: A recruiter is someone who finds, screens and pitches candidates for open positions at client companies, working a phone and a job board from a desk, measured by how many hires stick past ninety days.

label: refugee
gloss: A refugee is someone who has fled their home country under threat of persecution, war, or violence, and who lives in temporary shelter while waiting for asylum decisions, work permits, and a chance to rebuild a life elsewhere.

label: reporter
gloss: A reporter is someone who chases news stories across a city beat, interviewing sources on deadline, checking facts against documents, and filing copy for an editor before the evening edition goes to press.

label: researcher
gloss: A researcher is someone who designs studies, collects data in labs or field sites, and writes up findings for peer review, usually working inside a university or institute with grant deadlines to meet.

label: retiree
gloss: A retiree is someone who has left paid work after a career, now spends mornings walking the neighborhood, tends a backyard garden, and fills afternoons with grandchildren, library books, and a standing Thursday card game.

label: revenant
gloss: A revenant is a being that walks back among the living after death, haunting the village graveyard at night and returning each year to the families who buried it.

label: reviewer
gloss: A reviewer is someone who reads submitted manuscripts, drafts, or work products closely and writes a verdict with specific objections and required changes for the author and editor to act on.

label: revolutionary
gloss: A revolutionary is someone who works to overthrow an established government or social order, plotting in safehouses, recruiting followers, and risking arrest, exile, or execution for the cause.

label: robot
gloss: A robot is a machine that carries out physical or computational tasks on command, sensing its surroundings through cameras and sensors and moving through factories, warehouses, or homes under programmed control.

label: rogue
gloss: A rogue is someone who lives by wits and nerve on the edges of respectable towns, running card games, forging letters of credit, and dodging constables and creditors one step ahead.

label: romantic
gloss: A romantic is someone who believes in grand love and sweeps through courtship with letters, midnight serenades, and gestures larger than the moment calls for, always hoping the next person will be the one.

label: saboteur
gloss: A saboteur is someone who works inside a factory, railway, or supply chain and secretly damages machinery, schedules, or materials to halt production for a rival power or cause.

label: sage
gloss: A sage is someone who has outlived three generations of quarrels, and who sits at the village well each evening answering questions about grief, debts, and marriage in few words.

label: saint
gloss: A saint is someone who has been recognized by the church for a life of extraordinary holiness, and who prays for the living, intercedes for the faithful, and is honored on a feast day.

label: scheduler
gloss: A scheduler is someone who builds and rebuilds shift rosters, booking staff, rooms and equipment into time slots across a hospital's clinics and answering to department heads when the calendar breaks.

label: scholar
gloss: A scholar is someone who spends long hours in archives and libraries reading old manuscripts, tests claims against primary sources, and publishes careful arguments for a small circle of specialist readers.

label: scientist
gloss: A scientist is someone who designs controlled experiments, collects measurements in a lab or field site, and publishes findings for review by peers in their field.

label: scout
gloss: A scout is someone who ranges ahead of a column or patrol through unmapped country, reading tracks, watching ridgelines and water sources, and reporting what lies ahead before the main body moves.

label: screener
gloss: A screener is someone who checks applicants, visitors, or items against a set of criteria at a gate, counter, or door, deciding who or what passes and who is turned away.

label: secretary
gloss: A secretary is someone who keeps an executive's calendar, answers the phone and types letters, files correspondence in cabinets, and books travel for a manager on a busy office floor.

label: shaman
gloss: A shaman is someone who enters trance in the village healing hut at night, drumming and singing to bring back the souls of the sick and to speak with ancestors on behalf of the families who come to them.

label: shapeshifter
gloss: A shapeshifter is a being that can take on the form of animals or other people at will, slipping into a wolf's hide or a stranger's face to move unseen through villages, forests, and the households of its prey.

label: shopaholic
gloss: A shopaholic is someone who spends most weekends and much of each paycheck buying clothes, gadgets, and home goods, often on credit, and who feels a rush from the act of purchasing more than from owning the items.

label: simulacrum
gloss: A simulacrum is a figure made to look and move like a living person, standing in a shop window that greets passersby with a rehearsed smile and never tires.

label: skeptic
gloss: A skeptic is someone who questions every claim put in front of them, asks for the evidence behind it, and withholds belief until the sources, numbers and reasoning have been checked.

label: smuggler
gloss: A smuggler is someone who moves contraband across borders and checkpoints for money, hiding goods in false compartments, hauling them through back roads at night, and paying off whoever stands in the way.

label: socialite
gloss: A socialite is someone who spends most evenings at galas, charity luncheons, and opening nights in the city's best venues, cultivating invitations and columns in the society pages and keeping a calendar full of other people's parties.

label: sociologist
gloss: A sociologist is someone who studies how people organize themselves into families, workplaces, classes and communities, gathering survey responses and interview transcripts and writing up what patterns of group life explain.

label: soldier
gloss: A soldier is someone who serves in an army, drilling on a parade ground, carrying a rifle and pack, taking orders from a sergeant, and fighting for the country that enlisted them.

label: sommelier
gloss: A sommelier is someone who runs the wine program of a restaurant, tasting and buying bottles, pairing vintages with the tasting menu, and steering diners toward a glass they will remember.

label: specialist
gloss: A specialist is someone who works within one narrow field of expertise, taking on the hard cases that others in the organization refer to them, and answers for the accuracy of every diagnosis, recommendation, or fix they sign off on.

label: spirit
gloss: A spirit is a disembodied being that lingers among the living, haunting old houses and crossroads, and answers only to those who call its name at dusk.

label: spy
gloss: A spy is someone who gathers secret information on a rival government or company, works under a false identity from a safe house or embassy post, and passes intelligence to handlers through dead drops and encrypted messages.

label: statistician
gloss: A statistician is someone who designs samples and experiments, fits models to messy survey and trial data in R or SAS, and explains to clinicians and managers how much uncertainty surrounds each number they are about to act on.

label: stoic
gloss: A stoic is someone who meets pain, loss, and bad news with a steady face and an even voice, keeping their composure through hardship and refusing to let emotion show or steer what they do.

label: strategist
gloss: A strategist is someone who plans the long game for an organization, weighing market data, rival moves and budget limits to decide which bets to fund and which to drop.

label: student
gloss: A student is someone who attends classes, reads assigned texts, and sits exams in a school, college, or training program, working toward a degree, certificate, or mastery of a subject.

label: subordinate
gloss: A subordinate is someone who works under orders at a regional freight depot, loading trucks, logging deliveries, and taking assignments each morning from whoever holds the clipboard.

label: summarizer
gloss: A summarizer is something that reads long documents, meeting transcripts, and email threads and returns a short account of the key points, keeping names, numbers, and decisions intact.

label: superfan
gloss: A superfan is someone who follows a band, team, or franchise through every tour stop, game, and release, keeps a shelf of memorabilia, and argues online about setlists and stats late into the night.

label: supervisor
gloss: A supervisor is someone who oversees a crew of workers on a shop floor or job site, assigning daily tasks, checking their output against schedules, and handling absences, complaints, and safety write-ups.

label: surfer
gloss: A surfer is someone who rides ocean waves on a board, paddling out before dawn to read swell direction and tide, and who spends most of each day in salt water chasing the next set.

label: survivor
gloss: A survivor is someone who has come through a disaster, assault, or long illness still alive and carries the aftermath daily, rebuilding routines, finances, and trust while speaking for others who did not make it.

label: swarm
gloss: A swarm is something that leaves the crowded hive with the old queen, clusters on a tree branch in a humming ball, and sends scouts out to find a new nest cavity.

label: swing voter
gloss: A swing voter is someone who goes to the polls every cycle without a fixed party loyalty, weighing each candidate's record, promises and local impact before deciding how to cast a ballot.

label: symbiont
gloss: A symbiont is an organism that lives permanently inside or against a host species, trading shelter and nutrients for its keep, and has no life apart from that partnership.

label: synthesizer
gloss: A synthesizer is someone who builds and plays electronic sounds on a rack of keyboards and modular patch cables in a studio or on tour, shaping tones night after night for a band.

label: teacher
gloss: A teacher is someone who stands before a classroom of children or teenagers each school day, planning lessons, grading essays and quizzes, and guiding students through reading, math, and science until they can work on their own.

label: technologist
gloss: A technologist is someone who designs, builds and tests working tools and systems in a lab or plant, applying applied science to real products and answering to engineers and production managers.

label: teenager
gloss: A teenager is someone who is between thirteen and nineteen years old, lives under a parent's roof, goes to school five days a week, and spends evenings texting friends and arguing about curfew.

label: theorist
gloss: A theorist is someone who builds explanatory models of how things work, testing them against data, publishing arguments in journals, and revising them when a case refuses to fit.

label: therapist
gloss: A therapist is someone who sits with clients in a private office for fifty-minute sessions, listens closely to what they say about their lives, and helps them work through anxiety, grief, and difficult relationships.

label: toddler
gloss: A toddler is someone who is roughly one to three years old, walks unsteadily through the household, gets into cupboards and pulls at cords, and communicates with parents and caregivers through single words and loud protest.

label: traditionalist
gloss: A traditionalist is someone who keeps the customs of their family and village unchanged, cooking the same recipes, observing the same feast days, and telling newcomers how things were always done here.

label: trainer
gloss: A trainer is someone who works with athletes, clients, or new employees in a gym, clinic, or company training room, building their skills through planned sessions, drills, and feedback.

label: translator
gloss: A translator is someone who renders written documents from one language into another, working from a desk with dictionaries, glossaries and a deadline, for publishers, courts and businesses that need the meaning carried over exactly.

label: tree
gloss: A tree is a living thing that stands rooted in one patch of soil for decades, drawing water up through its trunk and feeding its leaves to the sun while birds nest in its branches.

label: trickster
gloss: A trickster is someone who wins people over with charm and misdirection, playing tricks on the proud and the gullible at village fairs, in taverns, and around campfires, and who treats every deception as a game.

label: tulpa
gloss: A tulpa is a being that lives inside its maker's mind, built from sustained visualization and conversation, and that keeps its own appearance, voice, and opinions through every waking hour.

label: tutor
gloss: A tutor is someone who sits beside one student at a time, working through homework, drills, and exam prep in a kitchen or library, adjusting each explanation until the learner can solve the next problem alone.

label: unemployed
gloss: An unemployed is someone who checks the job boards each morning, files weekly claims with the state office, and takes any paying work offered while living on savings and a shrinking bank balance until a new job turns up.

label: union member
gloss: A union member is someone who pays monthly dues, works a shift under a collective bargaining agreement, and votes in local meetings on contract terms, grievances, and whether to strike.

label: validator
gloss: A validator is someone who checks submitted records and test results against published rules, stamps those that pass, and returns the rest to their authors with the exact field that failed.

label: vampire
gloss: A vampire is an undead creature that rises at night, drinks the blood of sleeping villagers, and retreats to a coffin in a castle crypt before dawn.

label: vegan
gloss: A vegan is someone who lives on plant foods alone, choosing grains, beans, vegetables and fruit at the grocery store and checking labels for milk, eggs, and gelatin.

label: vegetarian
gloss: A vegetarian is someone who eats no meat, poultry, or fish, shops for groceries with that rule in mind, and reads ingredient labels for animal stock or gelatin before buying.

label: veteran
gloss: A veteran is someone who has served in the armed forces, having spent years in uniform on active duty and carrying that service into civilian life as a standing part of who they are.

label: veterinarian
gloss: A veterinarian is someone who examines sick and injured animals in a clinic or on farm visits, diagnoses illness, sets fractures, performs surgery, and advises owners on vaccines, diet, and care.

label: victim
gloss: A victim is someone who was robbed, assaulted, or defrauded by another person and now lives with the loss, reporting it to police, giving statements to prosecutors, and rebuilding a life after the harm.

label: vigilante
gloss: A vigilante is someone who takes the law into their own hands, patrolling streets at night and meting out punishment to suspected criminals without warrant, trial, or any authority beyond their own sense of justice.

label: villager
gloss: A villager is someone who farms a small plot outside the walls of a river town, hauling water from the well at dawn and trading eggs and wool at Saturday market.

label: virtue-aligned AI
gloss: A virtue-aligned AI is a system that answers questions and completes tasks for everyday users, holding honesty and care as the standing rules it checks each reply against before sending it.

label: virtuoso
gloss: A virtuoso is someone who plays the violin in concert halls before sold-out audiences, practicing six hours a day to keep technique sharp for demanding solo concertos.

label: virus
gloss: A virus is a microscopic particle that rides a protein shell into living cells, takes over their machinery to copy itself, and bursts out to infect the next cell.

label: visionary
gloss: A visionary is someone who sees where a company, a field, or a community could be in ten or twenty years and spends most days pitching that future to investors, engineers, and skeptical colleagues until they build it.

label: void
gloss: A void is something that hangs as an empty expanse between the stars, holding no matter, light, or air, and that swallows whatever drifts across its edge.

label: volunteer
gloss: A volunteer is someone who gives unpaid hours to a food bank or a youth league, working shifts, stocking shelves, and coaching kids on weekends for no wages and no obligation to return.

label: voter
gloss: A voter is someone who registers at a county office, casts a ballot at a precinct or by mail in each election, and chooses candidates and measures for city, state, and national offices.

label: wanderer
gloss: A wanderer is someone who walks from town to town with a pack on the shoulder, sleeping in barns and roadside camps and living on what strangers give for mended tools and songs.

label: warrior
gloss: A warrior is someone who trains daily with sword and shield, takes up a lord's cause in border wars, and holds a fighting line beside sworn companions until the battle is won or the body falls.

label: whale
gloss: A whale is a large marine mammal that surfaces to breathe through a blowhole, dives for krill and fish in cold open ocean, and travels alone or in pods along migration routes through the year.

label: widow
gloss: A widow is someone who has outlived a spouse and lives on alone, often managing a household, finances, and grief without the partner who once shared the daily routine.

label: wind
gloss: A wind is something that moves across open water and farmland, pushing sailboats, bending grain, and carrying seed and sand from one coast to the next.

label: witch
gloss: A witch is someone who works in a village cottage with herbs, cauldrons, and a cat, brewing remedies and reading omens for the farmers and families who come to the door after dark.

label: witness
gloss: A witness is someone who saw an event firsthand and takes the stand in a courtroom, swearing an oath to describe under cross-examination exactly what their own eyes recorded.

label: workaholic
gloss: A workaholic is someone who keeps working past the end of every shift, takes the laptop to bed, and feels restless and guilty on weekends when no deadline or inbox is waiting.

label: wraith
gloss: A wraith is a ghostly, spectral being that haunts the ruins of old battlefields and abandoned roads, drifting between the living and the dead and luring travelers off the path at night.

label: writer
gloss: A writer is someone who spends most mornings at a desk drafting, cutting, and revising prose or verse, working from notes, deadlines, and editors' comments until a manuscript is ready to send out.

label: zealot
gloss: A zealot is someone who pursues a cause with total devotion, pressing followers and rivals alike to abandon every doubt, compromise or competing loyalty until the cause alone governs their days.

label: zeitgeist
gloss: A zeitgeist is something that settles over a generation, shaping what its people fear, desire, and argue about, from the front pages to the talk at kitchen tables.
